entry.title: 23 Marina
entry.note: Fresh OSM API on 2026-10-10 confirms exact Q216264 podium 186351097, independent octagonal shaft 907717855 and mast 186351102; all geometry matches map-parts. Signed heading -0.72546838218 puts +X southeast and +Z southwest. The independently offset shaft/mast and asymmetric fifth podium edge fix the registration phase; an unsigned long axis alone would not. Architect completed photos show diagonal broad blue facets alternating with native cardinal balcony faces and open four-canopy crown. Door bay on native -Z (northeast) podium front remains photograph-based reconstruction, not a surveyed entrance point; no doorway-bearing claim. Source Y=0 is reconstructed street datum and tip 392.4 m follows CVU record rather than inconsistent 39/393/395 m map tags. Accept 2 m footprint / 1 degree reconstruction allowance; automatic footprint replacement disabled. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
